text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning your sex was not a barrier to being selected, nor was it the determining factor between you. While an all-male panel might reflect poor organizational diversity practices or breach internal hospital HR guidelines requiring gender-balanced interview panels, it does not indicate unlawful sex discrimination against you. 

Raising the panel's gender composition would likely appear unfounded and undermine your professional credibility. Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your requested feedback. Focus your inquiries on objective criteria, asking how the panel evaluated management qualifications and broad leadership experience relative to your doctorate and eight years of section leadership.
